material_claim: Eligible apps must be fully published by the deadline; first public release must occur in the window; app must use RevenueCat for a purchase or Ads and function as depicted.
architecture_use: Makes a live store build RevenueCat lifecycle and demo parity hard scope.
fallback_or_limitation: Exa fetched full text; rules can change and must be rechecked before submission.

material_claim: RevenueCat Design rewards app-development craft; Best App for Galaxy requires Galaxy Store publication and thoughtful Galaxy optimization.
architecture_use: Keep Design primary and Galaxy conditional on real store and device proof.
fallback_or_limitation: Overview language is subordinate to official rules where they conflict.

material_claim: Intake checks store URL package ID required fields video icon and screenshots; screeners must watch the first two video minutes.
architecture_use: Treat submission assets and judge-observable proof as must ship.
fallback_or_limitation: Process is described as subject to change.

material_claim: Instant Voice Thread saves locally before AI preserves text Share and deterministic reset and requires human confirmation before Start.
architecture_use: Sets the non-negotiable data order and fallback.
fallback_or_limitation: User and device validation is still pending.

material_claim: H2 Forward Thread and I2-V1 Direct Trace-back Connector are locked for later runs.
architecture_use: Trace-back evidence accessibility and visual-state proof enter the vertical slice.
fallback_or_limitation: Visual hypotheses remain unvalidated.

page_title: Run 9 Monetization Retention and Growth Report
material_claim: M1 A1 A2 R1 R2 R3 R4 and G1-G3 define the approved monetization and metric system.
architecture_use: Carries one pro entitlement free boundary event taxonomy and conditional OneSignal path into architecture.
fallback_or_limitation: Price allowance conversion and retention are hypotheses.

material_claim: The page shows Android SDK 10.15.1; Galaxy support begins at 10.7.0 through purchases-store-galaxy and GalaxyConfiguration; physical Galaxy hardware is required for test purchases; other hybrid SDK support is coming.
architecture_use: Select native Android and make Galaxy a physical purchase gate.
fallback_or_limitation: Exa full fetch and Firecrawl forced-live query agreed; versions can change.

material_claim: React Native Galaxy support is available from SDK 10.3.0 with a separate Galaxy package and physical test device.
architecture_use: Treat React Native as plausible but not lower-touch for native product surfaces.
fallback_or_limitation: Does not measure bridge reliability for this product.

material_claim: The page documents Capacitor setup for Google Play and App Store but contains no Galaxy section.
architecture_use: Do not depend on a Capacitor Galaxy billing path.
fallback_or_limitation: Absence can change; current Android page explicitly says other hybrid support is coming.

material_claim: The wrapper documents Google Play and iOS App Store common-source integration and generated native iOS bindings but not Galaxy.
architecture_use: Defer KMP until an Apple client has product evidence.
fallback_or_limitation: No claim that Galaxy can never be added with platform-specific code.

material_claim: RevenueCat can create cached anonymous IDs when no custom app user ID is supplied; anonymous identity is not cross-platform account continuity.
architecture_use: Use no-account first value and defer account merging.
fallback_or_limitation: Uninstall and cross-device behavior must be disclosed.

material_claim: Restore purchases should be user initiated because the operating system may prompt; anonymous consumed one-time purchases have Billing Client 8 limitations.
architecture_use: Expose explicit restore and avoid consumables in M1.
fallback_or_limitation: Store sandbox behavior still needs tests.

material_claim: RevenueCat Galaxy validation requires a Seller Portal service account private key and Galaxy app record.
architecture_use: Make external account and secret setup an early dependency.
fallback_or_limitation: No builder setup exists yet.

material_claim: Most apps need one entitlement and several products can unlock it for their active duration.
architecture_use: Use one pro access decision across stores.
fallback_or_limitation: Implementation still needs lifecycle tests.

material_claim: Offerings group equivalent products into packages and permit remote presentation changes.
architecture_use: Map Play and Galaxy monthly and annual products to the default Offering.
fallback_or_limitation: Remote configuration does not replace store product activation.

material_claim: Android recommends window size classes and Compose Material 3 Adaptive; apps should respond to window rather than device assumptions.
architecture_use: Use compact medium and expanded UI without a second layout runtime.
fallback_or_limitation: User value of a particular two-pane layout must still be tested.

material_claim: Jetpack WindowManager exposes fold state and hinge bounds.
architecture_use: Avoid placing controls on the hinge and preserve state across posture changes.
fallback_or_limitation: Physical device behavior remains untested.

material_claim: Multi-window is standard from Android 12 and Android 16 overrides some fixed orientation aspect and resizability restrictions on large screens.
architecture_use: Make window resizing a must-test state transition.
fallback_or_limitation: OEM desktop-window behavior varies.

material_claim: App widgets are hosted by another app such as the home screen and have constrained RemoteViews or Glance behavior.
architecture_use: Promise a home widget only after implementation; do not assume universal lock-screen hosting.
fallback_or_limitation: Host availability and locked placement are OEM-dependent.

page_title: Restrictions on starting a foreground service from the background
material_claim: Widget interaction can be a background-start exemption but Android 14+ separately checks while-in-use microphone permission and can throw SecurityException when unavailable.
architecture_use: Make locked microphone behavior a physical spike with unlock fallback.
fallback_or_limitation: Exact keyguard and OEM behavior is not resolved by the general rule.

material_claim: Keystore keys can be non-exportable hardware-backed and restricted to authorized cryptographic uses.
architecture_use: Use a non-exportable device key for the local vault.
fallback_or_limitation: Hardware backing varies; StrongBox is not necessary by default.

material_claim: Android recommends AES CBC or GCM with 256-bit keys and specifically lists AES/GCM/NoPadding.
architecture_use: Use authenticated AES-256-GCM for app-private content.
fallback_or_limitation: Implementation misuse still requires tests and review.

material_claim: Android backup supports encryption and exclusion rules; custom exports increase leak risk if poorly implemented.
architecture_use: Exclude protected vault files and make export explicit through the system picker.
fallback_or_limitation: Excluding content means reinstall is not a thread-recovery feature.

material_claim: Developers must declare app and third-party SDK collection; voice recordings are a named data category.
architecture_use: Create an SDK and data inventory before Play submission.
fallback_or_limitation: The builder remains responsible for final declarations.

material_claim: Android recommends manual TalkBack testing and automated accessibility checks.
architecture_use: Include TalkBack semantics large-text and device testing in must ship.
fallback_or_limitation: Automated checks cannot replace user testing.

material_claim: Overall bad-behavior thresholds include 1.09% user-perceived crash and 0.47% ANR.
architecture_use: Use Play vitals as launch-quality evidence and minimal crash reporting.
fallback_or_limitation: Thresholds are platform policy signals not proof of a delightful product.

material_claim: Excessive launch thresholds are cold 5 seconds warm 2 seconds and hot 1.5 seconds.
architecture_use: Defer network and heavy initialization from capture launch.
fallback_or_limitation: Product capture-start usability is a separate accepted gate.

material_claim: Frame deadlines depend on refresh rate; frozen frames exceed 700 milliseconds.
architecture_use: Keep connector motion interruptible and supply static reduced motion.
fallback_or_limitation: Device profiling is still required.

page_title: Target API level requirements for Google Play apps
material_claim: Starting August 31 2026 new apps and updates must target Android 16 API 36 or higher.
architecture_use: Target API 36 from project creation.
fallback_or_limitation: Google documents an extension path but the plan does not rely on it.

page_title: App testing requirements for new personal developer accounts
material_claim: Affected new personal accounts need at least 12 testers continuously opted in for 14 days before production-access application; Google may require more testing.
architecture_use: Start a meaningful closed test on August 19 and keep Galaxy parallel.
fallback_or_limitation: Account applicability and tester engagement definition are unresolved; Firecrawl live cross-check agreed.

material_claim: Subscriptions require sustained recurring value clear localized terms actual billing and cancellation information and a visible free path when one exists.
architecture_use: Keep cloud value recurring and paywall dismissible after value.
fallback_or_limitation: Living policy must be rechecked before submission.

material_claim: Galaxy distribution requires a Samsung account Seller Portal registration and commercial seller status for free or paid apps.
architecture_use: Treat Galaxy account status as an external critical-path gate.
fallback_or_limitation: Builder has not confirmed an account or approval.

page_title: Get Started with the Galaxy Store Developer API
material_claim: Apps must first be registered in Seller Portal; API use requires a service account JWT and access token.
architecture_use: Do not defer store and service-account setup until feature completion.
fallback_or_limitation: Exa full fetch and Firecrawl forced-live query agreed.

material_claim: Apps that access or transmit user data need an in-app privacy policy and Seller Portal URL covering collection purpose sharing retention deletion and rights.
architecture_use: Make privacy policy and Galaxy Data Safety must ship.
fallback_or_limitation: Country-specific review can add requirements.

page_title: Register Your App in Seller Portal
material_claim: Seller Portal collects Data Safety information and reviewer comments; apps requiring login need a review account.
architecture_use: Use no-account first value and provide complete reviewer instructions.
fallback_or_limitation: Reviewer behavior and timing are external.

material_claim: Hosted free functions have 256 MB memory a 150-second wall-clock limit a 2-second CPU limit and a 150-second idle-response timeout.
architecture_use: Keep the request bounded and preserve a local fallback rather than invent a latency promise.
fallback_or_limitation: Real cold-start and provider behavior are unmeasured.

material_claim: Secret and service-role keys belong in Edge Functions and bypass row-level security; they must never ship in a browser or app.
architecture_use: Keep provider store and webhook secrets server-side.
fallback_or_limitation: Operational access control still needs configuration.

material_claim: Free currently includes two active projects 500 MB database 5 GB egress and 50000 monthly active users.
architecture_use: Use development and production projects within the current early free tier.
fallback_or_limitation: Pricing and inactivity policy can change.

page_title: Data controls in the OpenAI platform
material_claim: API data is not used for training unless opted in; default abuse-monitoring logs can contain customer content and be retained up to 30 days; approved controls can differ.
architecture_use: Disclose actual provider retention and avoid persistent API features.
fallback_or_limitation: Provider is proposed for the spike not finally selected.

material_claim: Run 9 observed GPT Transcribe at US$0.0045 per minute and low short-context generation prices.
architecture_use: Instrument actual cost per successful draft rather than assume margin.
fallback_or_limitation: Price does not prove accuracy latency retries privacy or support cost.

material_claim: OneSignal recommends explaining value and prompting after a value moment rather than first launch.
architecture_use: Keep notification permission conditional and post-value.
fallback_or_limitation: Vendor conversion examples are not independent evidence.

page_title: Sending messages with the OneSignal API
material_claim: The API can target a user alias and schedule future delivery.
architecture_use: Schedule only one requested restart reminder from the server.
fallback_or_limitation: Provider acceptance does not prove device delivery.

material_claim: A stored message ID can cancel a scheduled message but cancellation may race an active send.
architecture_use: Cancel on every suppressing transition and make stale deep links safe.
fallback_or_limitation: Race behavior requires integration testing.

material_claim: RevenueCat Pro is currently free through US$2500 monthly tracked revenue and then charges its published rate.
architecture_use: Fits early operation while preserving one purchase system.
fallback_or_limitation: Pricing can change and tracked revenue is a vendor-defined measure.

material_claim: The current free tier supports unlimited mobile push with bounded Journey and in-app-message features.
architecture_use: The single conditional reminder can begin without another paid plan.
fallback_or_limitation: Server-side suppression is still necessary and features can change.

page_title: Get started with Crashlytics for Android
material_claim: Firebase Crashlytics reports Android crashes non-fatal errors and ANRs and requires a forced test crash to verify setup.
architecture_use: Use it as the opted-in cross-flavor crash path while Play vitals remains available for Play.
fallback_or_limitation: Do not add the optional Analytics dependency or breadcrumb collection.

material_claim: Crashlytics collects automatically by default but supports disabling automatic collection and user opt-in; custom logs keys and user IDs can add data.
architecture_use: Disable automatic collection until diagnostics opt-in and ban content logs keys and user IDs.
fallback_or_limitation: Opt-in reduces report coverage and must be measured.

material_claim: Firebase currently lists Crashlytics as no-cost.
architecture_use: Add minimal cross-store crash reporting without a paid service assumption.
fallback_or_limitation: Pricing and terms can change.
